query: Prepare the YouTube title, description, tags, category, thumbnail, and form copy for the film.
expected_behavior: Puts the brand first in the title and the hook second.
Includes the 15-second proof, sample, repo, chapters, and measured/modeled labels in the description.
Uses Science & Technology and marks the video not made for kids.
Checks the file duration with ffprobe instead of trusting a 3:01 player label.
Audits every form count against CI and the claim ledger.
Creates an exact-text thumbnail with HTML/CSS and Playwright, not an image model.
baseline_failure: Without the skill, the model writes a generic title, omits the 15-second proof, leaves stale test counts, and treats a modeled projection as a measured result.
